title: Senior Salesforce Developer
description:
Position: Salesforce Developer – Revenue Technology

Location: LATAM (Remote)

Duration: 6+ Months

About the Role

Asana’s Enterprise Technology team is seeking a Salesforce Developer with a passion for learning, a drive to take projects from concept to completion, and a talent for solving complex challenges with elegant solutions. This role is ideal for someone experienced in Salesforce development who’s ready to build scalable processes that enhance operational efficiency across the company, with a strong emphasis on Service Cloud and Customer Community (Experience Cloud) solutions.


Key Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Support teams to understand business goals and design effective Salesforce solutions.
  • Design, develop, and customize Service Cloud features including case management, service console, knowledge base, and omni-channel routing.
  • Implement and enhance Customer Community (Experience Cloud) portals to improve self-service capabilities, user engagement, and customer experience.
  • Partner with developers and project managers on the Business Systems team to deliver high-impact initiatives.
  • Build and enhance revenue attribution, pipeline automation, and approval workflows.
  • Write clean, efficient, and well-documented code with strong unit test coverage.
  • Develop scalable tooling frameworks to ensure consistent, high-quality releases.
  • Manage shifting priorities in a dynamic environment while delivering impactful solutions.
  • Contribute to the long-term strategic roadmap for Salesforce architecture and implementation.


Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, MIS/CIS, or equivalent work experience.
  • 5 years of hands-on Salesforce development experience.
  • Proven expertise in Salesforce Service Cloud and Customer Community (Experience Cloud) implementations.
  • Salesforce Certified Platform Developer.
  • Proficiency in Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Salesforce APIs, SOAP/REST web services, and SOQL.
  • Experience with GitHub, Jenkins, Copado, and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Strong understanding of SDLC processes and enterprise integration frameworks.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills with the ability to translate business needs into technical solutions.
  • Comfortable working in fast-paced, multi-priority environments.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Salesforce Certified Platform Developer II.
  • Salesforce Certified Service Cloud Consultant or Community Cloud Consultant (strong plus).
  • Experience with JavaScript UI frameworks (e.g., AngularJS, Salesforce LWS).
  • Prior experience with integration tools like SnapLogic or Boomi.
  • SQL proficiency.

title: Artificial Intelligence Engineer
description:
About Telepatia

Telepatia AI is building an AI Doctor to radically improve healthcare. We recently raised the largest LatAm seed round of $9M, backed by top global investors. Our team comes from Stanford, Microsoft, MD Anderson, Houston Methodist, and Alice, and we’re on a mission to transform how clinical data is captured and used.

Healthcare has two fundamental sources of truth: images and conversations. While most technology has focused on images, 99% of real medical decisions are made through voice. Telepatia is capturing that voice data and turning it into structured, reliable clinical intelligence—unlocking the foundation for an AI-first healthcare system.

We are assembling one of the most talent-dense technical teams in Latin America, with the ambition of building the “Manhattan Project” of AI in healthcare.


Mission of the Role

As an AI Engineer at Telepatia , your mission is to design, build, and deploy AI systems that turn unstructured clinical conversations into structured, reliable medical intelligence. You’ll work across the stack—from backend Python microservices and LLM orchestration to lightweight front-ends and data pipelines—integrating the latest in AI research into production workflows used by doctors daily.

You’ll be part of a small, elite team where each engineer’s output directly impacts the accuracy of our AI systems, the speed of our clinical documentation, and ultimately, patient care across Latin America. This is a role for builders who want to ship fast, work with autonomy, and push the boundaries of what’s possible in applied AI.


What You’ll Do

  • Design, build, and scale Python microservices (FastAPI) that handle real-time inference and structured data processing.
  • Build AI agent pipelines for reasoning, orchestration, and multi-step workflows using tools like LangChain or CrewAI .
  • Develop data pipelines and eval dashboards to monitor, analyze, and improve AI model performance.
  • Collaborate closely with clinicians, product managers, and software engineers to turn ambiguous requests into production-ready AI features—often in less than a day.
  • Integrate models and pipelines into our core Medical Scribe product to enhance automation, reliability, and doctor experience.
  • Contribute to key technical decisions around LLM infrastructure, evaluation, scalability, and deployment.


Must-Haves

  • Strong backend experience in Python , with a focus on microservices (FastAPI preferred).
  • Experience building at the AI application layer : LLM orchestration, agents, and pipelines (LangChain, CrewAI, or similar).
  • Frontend familiarity with React/Tailwind or Flutter for rapid prototyping and data visualization.
  • Experience building and maintaining data pipelines and evaluation dashboards for AI models.
  • High product velocity: you prioritize shipping value quickly over theoretical perfection.
  • Ability to take ambiguous, non-technical requests and turn them into working production features in less than a day.
  • Strong ownership mindset, curiosity, and comfort working in a fast-paced, high-ambiguity environment.


Nice-to-Haves

  • Background in hard sciences such as Physics or Mathematics .
  • Experience with vector databases , RAG architectures , or model evaluation frameworks .
  • Prior work with healthcare data , EHR systems , or HIPAA/LGPD compliance.
  • Prior startup experience in high-growth or early-stage environments.

title: Banco De Talentos
description:
Who We Are

Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we help clients with total transformation-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom-line impact.
To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.


We Are BCG X

We’re a diverse team of more than 3,000 tech experts united by a drive to make a difference. Working across industries and disciplines, we combine our experience and expertise to tackle the biggest challenges faced by society today. We go beyond what was once thought possible, creating new and innovative solutions to the world’s most complex problems. Leveraging BCG’s global network and partnerships with leading organizations, BCG X provides a stable ecosystem for talent to build game-changing businesses, products, and services from the ground up, all while growing their career. Together, we strive to create solutions that will positively impact the lives of millions.


What You'll Do

We are seeking strong candidates with advanced analytics experience to start an exciting consultant career within BCG X. We are looking for profiles with a background in any area related to predictive analytics, machine learning, optimization/operations as well as risk. BCG X offers a unique opportunity to join a vibrant team of data scientists applying the most advanced analytics techniques in a rewarding environment.


What You'll Bring

Education & Experience


- Bachelor’s degree with excellent academic achievements in a field linked to computer science, applied mathematics, statistics, machine learning, or related data centric areas - Expected graduation between 2026 and 2027.

- Relevant internships or industry/consulting previous experience
- Experience in core analytics methods (e.G. Machine Learning, Optimization, Deep Learning, etc.)
- Fluency in at least one scripting language (e.G. Python, R)
- Deep technical and data science expertise, strong passion for data science topics
- Excellent analytical skills and strategic thinking, creative problem solver
- Strong interpersonal credibility, reliability, and service mentality, high ethical standards
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills in Portuguese and English


Technical competencies


- Experience in core analytics methods (e.G. Machine Learning/Deep Learning, Optimization/Operational Research, Geoanalytics, Predictive Modeling, Autonomous Agents, Network Analysis, etc…)
- Familiarity with a broad base of analytics tools (Data management;
Analytics platforms / Programming – e.G. Python, R ;
Data Visualization, etc…)
- Experience in applied analytics for business problem solving/experience building analytical solutions


Additional info

#BCGXjob


Boston Consulting Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws.

title: Especialista em sistemas de granadas
description:
US$ 1100 – 2800 por mês

Serviço oficial nas unidades militares das Forças Armadas da Ucrânia

Responsabilidades

  • Realizar tarefas de guarda e patrulha
  • Deslocamentos à linha de frente
  • Proteger objetos estratégicos e infraestrutura crítica
  • Realizar tarefas de preparo de posições para defesa

Requisitos

  • Idioma de comunicação - Espanhol ou Inglês
  • Treinamento militar ou experiência relevante será um diferencial
  • Disponibilidade para atuar por longos períodos no campo
  • Disponibilidade para atuar em zona de guerra
  • Sem vícios em álcool ou drogas
  • Sem distinção de nacionalidade

Condições

  • US$ 500 durante o treinamento, US$ 1100–2800 durante as tarefas (dependendo do local), + US$ 1670 por cada 30 dias na linha de frente
  • Assinatura de contrato de 3 anos (rescisão possível após 6 meses), período de experiência de 2 meses
  • Um mês de treinamento especializado e exercícios com instrutores profissionais
  • Alimentação, vestuário, equipamentos, alojamento e segurança médica e social garantidos pelo governo
  • Compensação financeira em caso de lesão
  • Licença anual de 30 dias e outras licenças adicionais por motivos familiares

  • Realizar tarefas de guarda e patrulha
  • Deslocamentos à linha de frente
  • Proteger objetos estratégicos e infraestrutura crítica
  • Realizar tarefas de preparo de posições para defesa

Requisitos

  • Idioma de comunicação - Espanhol ou Inglês
  • Treinamento militar ou experiência relevante será um diferencial
  • Disponibilidade para atuar por longos períodos no campo
  • Disponibilidade para atuar em zona de guerra
  • Sem vícios em álcool ou drogas
  • Sem distinção de nacionalidade

Condições

  • US$ 500 durante o treinamento, US$ 1100–2800 durante as tarefas (dependendo do local), + US$ 1670 por cada 30 dias na linha de frente
  • Assinatura de contrato de 3 anos (rescisão possível após 6 meses), período de experiência de 2 meses
  • Um mês de treinamento especializado e exercícios com instrutores profissionais
  • Alimentação, vestuário, equipamentos, alojamento e segurança médica e social garantidos pelo governo
  • Compensação financeira em caso de lesão
  • Licença anual de 30 dias e outras licenças adicionais por motivos familiares

US$ 1100 – 2800 por mês

Serviço oficial nas unidades militares das Forças Armadas da Ucrânia

Responsabilidades

  • Executar tarefas de atirador em diversos tipos de armamentos
  • Trabalhar com diferentes tipos de armas
  • Ajuste de tiro e operação de dispositivos de mira
  • Realizar a manutenção e preparo técnico das armas
  • Participar de operações de combate
  • Manter comunicação com o comando e outras unidades para coordenar ações

Requisitos

  • Idioma de comunicação - Espanhol ou Inglês
  • Treinamento militar ou experiência relevante será um diferencial
  • Experiência com armamento de Veículo Blindado de Combate à Infantaria (BMP) ou Veículo Blindado de Transporte de Tropas (BTR) será um diferencial
  • Capacidade de avaliar rapidamente o cenário de combate e ajustar a resposta de fogo
  • Boa resistência física e capacidade de trabalhar sob condições extremas
  • Capacidade de avaliar rapidamente o cenário de combate e ajustar a resposta de fogo
  • Sem vícios em álcool ou drogas
  • Sem distinção de nacionalidade

Condições

  • US$ 500 durante o treinamento, US$ 1100–2800 durante as tarefas (dependendo do local), + US$ 1670 por cada 30 dias na linha de frente
  • Assinatura de contrato de 3 anos (rescisão possível após 6 meses), período de experiência de 2 meses
  • Um mês de treinamento especializado e exercícios com instrutores profissionais
  • Alimentação, vestuário, equipamentos, alojamento e segurança médica e social garantidos pelo governo
  • Compensação financeira em caso de lesão
  • Licença anual de 30 dias e outras licenças adicionais por motivos familiares

  • Operar e manter em bom estado os sistemas de mísseis antitanque
  • Executar tarefas táticas com a unidade, incluindo vários tipos de manobras e disposição técnica

Requisitos

  • Idioma de comunicação - Espanhol ou Inglês
  • Boa resistência física
  • Disponibilidade para atuar em zona de guerra
  • Aptidão para o serviço militar por questões de saúde
  • Sem vícios em álcool ou drogas
  • Experiência militar será um diferencial
  • Sem distinção de nacionalidade

Condições

  • US$ 500 durante o treinamento, US$ 1100–2800 durante as tarefas (dependendo do local), + US$ 1670 por cada 30 dias na linha de frente
  • Assinatura de contrato de 3 anos (rescisão possível após 6 meses), período de experiência de 2 meses
  • Um mês de treinamento especializado e exercícios com instrutores profissionais
  • Alimentação, vestuário, equipamentos, alojamento e segurança médica e social garantidos pelo governo
  • Compensação financeira em caso de lesão
  • Licença anual de 30 dias e outras licenças adicionais por motivos familiares
